title: Ghost Grid Demo Now Available!
author: Crazy_Passage_8553
selftext:
**Looking for playtesters and feedback on my AI-vibe-coded stealth puzzle game, Ghost Grid!**

Hey everyone!

I'm a game designer experimenting with AI-assisted development, and I've been building **Ghost Grid**, a turn-based cyberpunk stealth puzzle game created largely through vibe coding.

The concept is simple: navigate a grid, avoid security patrols, hack systems, and complete objectives. Every move matters, and the puzzles get progressively more complex.

The game is currently playable for free in your browser, and I'd love some honest feedback!

I'm especially interested in thoughts on the gameplay, difficulty, controls, visual design, and overall fun factor.

This is both a passion project and an experiment in seeing how far AI-assisted game development can go.

**Play Ghost Grid:** [https://hidden-current-studios.itch.io/ghost-grid-demo](https://hidden-current-studios.itch.io/ghost-grid-demo)

Thanks to anyone willing to give it a try!
